mapper.insert: WITH feature_rows AS ( SELECT f.*, (f.features->>'ret60d')::numeric AS ret_60d, (f.features->>'riskAdjRet60d')::numeric AS risk_adj_ret_60d, (f.features->>'drawdown60d')::numeric AS drawdown_60d, (f.features->>'tradeAmount20dAvg')::numeric AS trade_amount_20d_avg FROM quant_core_feature_snapshot f WHERE f.model_code = #{modelCode} AND f.signal_date = #{signalDate} ), ranked_features AS ( SELECT *, COALESCE(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY risk_adj_ret_60d), 0) AS risk_adj_rank, COALESCE(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ret_60d), 0) AS ret_rank, COALESCE(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY trade_amount_20d_avg), 0) AS liquidity_rank, COALESCE(1 + drawdown_60d, 0.5) AS drawdown_score FROM feature_rows WHERE ret_60d IS NOT NULL AND risk_adj_ret_60d IS NOT NULL AND trade_amount_20d_avg IS NOT NULL ), scored AS ( SELECT *, ( 0.45 * risk_adj_rank + 0.30 * ret_rank + 0.15 * liquidity_rank + 0.10 * GREATEST(LEAST(drawdown_score, 1), 0) ) AS baseline_score FROM ranked_features ), final_rows AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY baseline_score DESC, trade_amount_20d_avg DESC NULLS LAST, asset_code ) AS signal_rank FROM scored ), probability_rows AS ( SELECT *, LEAST(0.80, GREATEST(0.05, 0.30 + baseline_score * 0.50)) AS calc_winner_prob, LEAST(0.35, GREATEST(0.15, 0.15 + (1 - ABS(baseline_score - 0.50) * 2) * 0.20)) AS calc_neutral_prob FROM final_rows ) INSERT INTO quant_core_signal ( model_code, model_version_id, signal_date, asset_code, asset_name, market, sector, winner_prob, neutral_prob, loser_prob, score, rank, target_weight, reason, risk_flags ) SELECT model_code, NULL, signal_date, asset_code, asset_name, market, sector, calc_winner_prob AS winner_prob, calc_neutral_prob AS neutral_prob, GREATEST(0.05, 1 - calc_winner_prob - calc_neutral_prob) AS loser_prob, baseline_score AS score, signal_rank AS rank, CASE WHEN signal_rank <= #{limit} THEN LEAST(0.15, 1.0 / #{limit}) ELSE 0 END AS target_weight, jsonb_build_object( 'engine', 'baseline_feature_score', 'riskAdjRank', risk_adj_rank, 'retRank', ret_rank, 'liquidityRank', liquidity_rank, 'drawdownScore', drawdown_score ) AS reason, jsonb_build_object( 'highVolatility', COALESCE((features->>'vol60d')::numeric, 0) > 0.05, 'deepDrawdown', COALESCE(drawdown_60d, 0) < -0.20, 'lowLiquidity', liquidity_rank < 0.20, 'baselineOnly', true ) AS risk_flags FROM probability_rows WHERE signal_rank <= #{limit} ON CONFLICT (model_code, signal_date, asset_code) DO UPDATE SET asset_name = EXCLUDED.asset_name, market = EXCLUDED.market, sector = EXCLUDED.sector, winner_prob = EXCLUDED.winner_prob, neutral_prob = EXCLUDED.neutral_prob, loser_prob = EXCLUDED.loser_prob, score = EXCLUDED.score, rank = EXCLUDED.rank, target_weight = EXCLUDED.target_weight, reason = EXCLUDED.reason, risk_flags = EXCLUDED.risk_flags, created_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id, model_code AS modelCode, model_version_id AS modelVersionId, signal_date AS signalDate, asset_code AS assetCode, asset_name AS assetName, market, sector, winner_prob AS winnerProb, neutral_prob AS neutralProb, loser_prob AS loserProb, score, rank, target_weight AS targetWeight, reason::text AS reason, risk_flags::text AS riskFlags, created_at AS createdAt FROM quant_core_signal WHERE model_code = #{modelCode} AND signal_date = #{signalDate} ORDER BY rank ASC NULLS LAST, score DESC, asset_code LIMIT #{limit}
